findings.bounded_correction: Validate exact report schemas, finite integer/cardinality/range fields, page identity and ascending complete scene sequence; correlate geometry header/request, contiguous returned depths, return/write/bit fields, call totals and explicit terminal reason. Preserve legitimate absent/refused/capped/unbacked outputs as distinct data, without deriving geometry or inventing triangle counts. findings.reuse: The retained native measurements satisfy independent stricter correspondence checks and may be reused under measured source366. A checker correction does not require another original physical run solely to regenerate the same rows.

source_assessment: Feature chain, build wiring and scalar/text C/Rust/Lua boundary were inspected. New C entrypoints are feature-gated; ordinary engine.c retains the exact accepted prefix and its one embedded NUL. No physical decoder or loader formula was changed.

Original geometry accessor is called once per requested depth in ascending order; TRUE/FALSE, changed-word bit outputs, absence and refused/no-helper cases remain distinct. Fan counts and array spans are safety limits, not replacement physical answers.

Loaded-table checks cover surface spans, face/point references, neighboring-array capacity limits and bounded page/depth arithmetic. Custom objects and face mismatches are explicitly refused rather than treated as original answers.

Observer paths use read-only shape getters, no frames or RNG draws; before/after digests cover model tables and safe referenced arrays. Addresses/padding participate in state digests, so cross-process whole-file equality is not a supported claim.

No concrete additional C/FFI memory, lifetime, ownership, arithmetic/FPU or feature-off defect was established within the verified loaded-retail contract. This is not a hardened arbitrary-asset parser proof.
